tweetText: Researchers have released new research explaining how diffusion models create art. This helps us understand the math behind AI creativity. via Google Research Blog
Nokia launched a new AI-powered platform built with NVIDIA. It helps mobile operators squeeze much more capacity out of their existing radio spectrum. via AI News
The US is using state and federal actions to build a new framework for AI safety. This approach helps create consistent rules that protect people while encouraging innovation. via OpenAI News
OpenAI introduced GPT-Red, an automated system that uses self-play to test AI models. This helps make AI safer and more resistant to attacks. via OpenAI News
Applied Computing raised $20M to build a foundation AI model for the oil and gas industry. This could revolutionize how plants operate and manage complex processes. via TechCrunch AI

Microsoft is training its sales team to pitch its own AI models as better value than OpenAI or Anthropic. This move shows the company is shifting focus to compete directly with its own partners. via TechCrunch AI
OpenAI released a $230 light-up keyboard for its Codex coding app. This shows the company is expanding into hardware despite ongoing legal battles. via TechCrunch AI
Thinking Machines released Inkling, its first open-source AI model. This move challenges generic AI by offering specialized alternatives for specific needs. via TechCrunch AI

A hacker accessed Suno's source code and found evidence that the AI music tool scraped YouTube for training data. This raises major legal questions about copyright and how AI models are built. via TechCrunch AI
Whatnot has acquired AI startup Shaped to improve its real-time shopping recommendations. This helps users find products they love more easily as the platform grows. via TechCrunch AI
